notes: [P2] scope/contract drift: the brief says the card's last line is `Press S to sell: N gold`. sellLine in src/hud.js and drawTowerCard in src/render.js instead show SELL_REFUSALS.over ('The round is not in play: start a round before selling') in muted ink when the status is not 'playing'. That behaviour was not asked for. It is harmless, since sellTower refuses then and the end card is drawn over the board, but it goes beyond the signed brief and adds a user-facing string nobody specified.

[P2] dead code: SELL_REFUSALS.missing in src/hud.js is exported and pinned by a test, but nothing in src reads it. main.js ignores sellTower's return value and the card only ever uses the 'over' entry, so the string can never reach the player.
